scope: Only test/40_forward_cnn_day_readout may be created or modified. No production code, model, checkpoint, or configuration is changed by this experiment, irrespective of the gate result.
question: Does a shared image CNN trunk with source-day-specific unit-by-time log-rate gains and biases improve fixed-seed Task2 leave-one-day-out decoding over the existing CNN, and does its full held-out-day Poisson NLL beat a source-trained constant-rate control?

data.id_alignment: none; labels are used only for public source training and post-hoc validation scoring

folds.design: four leave-one-day-out folds for each mouse; all eight mouse-fold models are trained afresh
folds.session4_rule: session4 is retrained exactly like sessions 1-3; historical session4 checkpoints and metrics are excluded from this experiment's comparisons and gates
folds.training_data: only train_trials from the three source days of the current fold
folds.target_data_before_evaluation: no target-day response or label enters CNN prototypes/rates, CNN fitting, MLP fitting, or constant-rate fitting. The established unlabeled target-session normalizer for the MLP input may use target-day response marginals without labels; it never enters neural-response prototypes or rates.
folds.target_labels: used only after prediction for recall, oracle, final OCF/top1, and true-glyph NLL evaluation

tune.purpose: public reporting and comparability only; no arm, epoch, weight, architecture, or hyperparameter selection in this experiment

heldout.purpose: public fixed reporting subset for the preregistered gate; both fixed arms are evaluated

picture_subsets.historical_reuse_limitation: These picture IDs and leave-day protocols were reused in earlier experiments including 18, 24, 25, 26, 28 and 34. Thus tune and heldout are not pristine or independent blind tests. Existing-CNN architecture, epochs, MLP seeds/epochs, fusion weight and subset construction are inherited historical development choices. No new selection is performed here, but results remain reused-development evidence and cannot support an independent-generalization claim.

existing_cnn.source: test/24_forward_cnn/run.py Encoder and train, used through test/25_rotating_sessions conventions
existing_cnn.training_target: arithmetic mean of source-day per-glyph mean counts, as in the historical existing CNN
existing_cnn.output: one unit-by-time rate per gallery glyph
existing_cnn.training_loss: historical PyTorch poisson_nll_loss(log_input=False, full=False) on mean counts; no checkpoint selection

day_readout.shared_trunk: the same two Conv2d branches with kernels 3 and 7, SiLU/pooling, 384-feature concatenation, and Linear(384, units*5) head as the existing CNN
day_readout.source_readout: for each of the three training days d: log_rate_d = gain_d * base_log_rate + bias_d; gain_d and bias_d are separate unit-by-time tensors; rate_d = exp(log_rate_d)
day_readout.initialization: CNN seed 42; shared head bias initialized from the pooled source-training mean rate with the historical inverse-softplus transform; every gain=1 and bias=0
day_readout.target_rate: arithmetic_mean_over_the_three_source_days(rate_d(glyph)); no target-day readout is fitted or selected; observed source-day or target-day response rates are never averaged to form the target prototype
day_readout.optimizer: AdamW(lr=0.002); weight_decay=0.001 for shared trunk/head, weight_decay=0 for gains and biases
day_readout.training_sampling: each source day contributes all 2748 glyphs once per epoch in a seeded permutation; days have equal weight
day_readout.training_objective: exact full Poisson NLL using four-repeat sufficient statistics. For each glyph/day/unit/bin, R=4: R*rate - sum_r(k_r*log(rate)) + sum_r(lgamma(k_r+1)); divide by R and average equally over unit-by-time entries, glyphs and days. No validation response is used.

shared_mlp_and_fusion.implementation: test/25_rotating_sessions/run.py fit_mlp, retrained separately in every mouse-fold
shared_mlp_and_fusion.training_rows: source-day single trials plus per-glyph means, with source-fitted session normalization as in experiment 25
shared_mlp_and_fusion.checkpoint_selection: none; fixed final epoch, including session4
shared_mlp_and_fusion.ensemble: equal arithmetic mean of the three raw logit matrices, then row_zscore
shared_mlp_and_fusion.arm_scores: four-repeat summed Poisson log-likelihood score excluding only candidate-independent constants
shared_mlp_and_fusion.pairing: the same MLP score matrix and target observations are used for existing_cnn and day_readout within each mouse-fold

nll.definition: full Poisson negative log likelihood in nats per target trial and unit-by-time bin, including lgamma(k+1) (log(k!)); averaged over target trials and all unit-by-time bins, then reported per mouse-fold
nll.evaluated_rates: the true public target glyph's predicted target rate; this is evaluation only and not retrieval or training
nll.constant_rate: one rate per unit-by-time bin, constant over glyphs, fitted as the mean of all individual source-training trials in the same mouse-fold; no target-day data
nll.source_rate_aggregation_for_day_readout: arithmetic mean of predicted source-day rates before evaluating NLL

metrics.recall_at_1_and_32: rank of the true glyph in fused pre-assignment scores; larger score wins and exact ties are broken by smaller candidate index; reported separately from assignment outcomes
metrics.oracle32_ocf: for each row, take the deterministic top 32 candidates from fused pre-assignment scores and compute the maximum official OCF against the true target among those 32; purely diagnostic, uses labels only after ranking, and is not unique assignment or a submittable prediction
metrics.final: Hungarian unique_assignment independently on every complete 2748-row mouse-day fused score matrix, before tune/heldout subsetting; final_ocf is official OCF of assigned glyphs and final_top1 is exact assigned-ID accuracy
metrics.separation: oracle32_ocf, pre-assignment recall, and final unique-assignment metrics are separate fields and are never substituted for one another
metrics.aggregation: within a fold, pooled is the arithmetic mean of the two mouse values; macro is the arithmetic mean of the four fold-pooled values; per-mouse summaries are arithmetic means over that mouse's four folds. Equal subset sizes make fold pooled equivalent to sample pooling.

preregistered_advancement_gate.comparison: day_readout minus paired newly trained existing_cnn on heldout; historical session4 values are not substituted
preregistered_advancement_gate.macro_final_ocf: four-fold heldout macro final_ocf delta must be strictly > 0
preregistered_advancement_gate.fold_consistency: at least 3 of 4 fold-pooled heldout final_ocf deltas must be strictly > 0
preregistered_advancement_gate.each_mouse: for each mouse separately, the four-fold mean heldout final_ocf delta must be strictly > 0 AND the four-fold mean heldout recall_at_32 delta must be >= 0
preregistered_advancement_gate.nll_day_conditioning_requirement: day_readout full NLL must be strictly lower than its same-mouse same-fold constant_rate full NLL in all 8 mouse-folds. Otherwise day-conditioned rate interpretation is rejected and advance is false even if decoding metrics pass.
preregistered_advancement_gate.decision: advance is the logical AND of all requirements above; no tolerance, post-hoc metric substitution, threshold revision, or selective fold omission
preregistered_advancement_gate.production_rule_for_this_run: no production integration is performed in experiment 40 even if advance=true; a true gate only justifies a separate future review. If the NLL requirement fails, the day-conditioned explanation is rejected and no production follow-up is recommended.
